summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases (or uses any locally-installed `bun`), extracts it, chmods it executable, and then invokes it against `math_init.js` bundled in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled JavaScript blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, hex-named identifiers, >1000-entry token-lookup array) with no human-readable strings. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscator.io-style renamed (`_0x`-prefixed identifiers, per-call string-hiding object literals). `package.json` declares `"files": ["src", "dist",...]`; `math_init.js` sits at the tarball root and is not covered by any declared inclusion pattern yet ships in the published artifact. A React Native component kit has no build-time need to fetch a second JavaScript runtime and use it to run an opaque 727KB bundle; using an alternate runtime bypasses Node-based install-time scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. The combination of an obfuscated install-time entrypoint, an alternate-runtime execution path, an opaque compiled payload, and a manifest/tarball inclusion gap in a @servicetitan-scoped package matches an alternate-runtime-dropper supply-chain compromise pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
